_note: PLACEHOLDER TIMES: every start and end below is an even split, not the real take. Retime each step from the take before cutting (see README.md). check_type is for people: the CLI treats a step as manual when check_question is "manual".

steps.title: Open the rim brake release
steps.common_mistake: Open the brake release so the tire clears the pads.

steps.title: Flip the quick release lever open
steps.check_question: Is the quick release lever swung open, standing out away from the fork blade?
steps.common_mistake: Flip the lever open; do not unscrew it like a nut.

steps.title: Unscrew the nut three to four turns
steps.check_question: Is the nut on the side opposite the lever backed off, with a gap between it and the fork end?
steps.common_mistake: Turn the nut past the safety tabs on the fork ends.

steps.title: Drop the wheel out of fork
steps.check_question: Is the wheel fully out of the fork, with both fork ends empty?
steps.common_mistake: Lift the bike and let the wheel drop straight down.

steps.title: Lower the fork onto the axle
steps.check_question: Is the axle seated all the way into the slots of both fork ends, with the wheel centered between the fork blades?
steps.common_mistake: Seat the axle fully in both fork ends.

steps.title: Snug the nut until lever resists
steps.common_mistake: Tighten the nut until the lever resists at halfway.

steps.title: Close the lever flat along blade
steps.check_question: Is the quick release lever closed, lying flat along the fork blade?
steps.common_mistake: Close the lever fully until it lies flat.

steps.title: Close the brake release
steps.check_question: Are the brake arms closed in, with a pad near the rim on each side?
steps.common_mistake: Close the brake release before riding.

steps.title: Spin the wheel and squeeze brake
steps.check_question: Is a hand squeezing the brake lever on the handlebar?
steps.common_mistake: Squeeze the brake to check it grips the rim.

safety: Lever must be fully closed and flat before riding
Close the brake release before riding
Seat the axle fully in both fork ends before riding
Squeeze the brake to test it before riding
